description:
Relevant Experience (Yrs) : 3 to 5+ Years of IT; 2-3 years of SQL experience along with SSIS knowledge, 2-3 years of .net Coding (C#) and Archer Developer knowledge
 Technical/Functional Skills : * SQL Server 2008 with SSIS
 * .net 4.0 (C#)
 * Archer knowledge
 * Oracle 11g
 Experience Required * At least 2-3 years hands-on experience in SQL and SSIS
 * 2-3 years of hands-on experience in .net coding
 * Archer Developer knowledge (Data feeds, Configuration Changes etc.)
 * Working experience in Full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) is required 
 * Good Communication, Analytical and Problem-Solving Skill. 
 Roles & Responsibilities : * Requirements Gathering.
 * Impact Analysis on System.
 * Development/Configuring changes and defects fixes. 
 * Assist Testing teams in testing the changes (SIT, UAT, PROD).
 * Migrating all changes to higher environments.
 

 


 Minimum Qualification : Bachelor of Engineering

 Job Status: permanent Position 
 
 Share the Profiles to mkonni(at)1stitsolutions(dot)com 

 
 Contact: 703 349 1214
 
 
 Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
